destinations.name: Huai'an
destinations.coordinates_source: midpoint of the kept spots across Huai'an's urban districts (Qingjiangpu, Huai'an, Huaiyin, Qinghe); Pipeline C to replace with the OSM place=city point
destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage has a page 'Huai'an' whose See, Do and Parks listings supply 11 of the 12 kept spots; Zhou Enlai's hometown and Wu Cheng'en's home town are its headline draws.
destinations.rank_reason: Regional prefecture-level city with a pilgrimage-level headline (Zhou Enlai) and canal heritage, but modest international pull: rank 4.
destinations.near_standalone_note: Sihong Ancient Xucheng (~75 km) and Hongze Lake Wetland Park (~70 km) are well over 40 km away and outside the city's bounds.

destinations.name: Suqian
destinations.coordinates_source: Suqian city (Sucheng/Suyu districts) centre, between Suqian Museum (osm/wikivoyage 33.938,118.298) and Santaishan; Pipeline C to confirm against OSM place=city
destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage has a page 'Suqian' with See, Museums, Historical sites and Parks listings supplying all four spots; Xiang Yu's hometown and Luoma Lake are its named draws.
destinations.rank_reason: Prefecture-level city, local base with four modest spots: rank 5.
destinations.near_standalone_note: Sihong Ancient Xucheng (~58 km) and Hongze Lake Wetland Park (~87 km) lie in Sihong County, outside Suqian city's bounds and span: standalone.

destinations.name: Xuzhou
destinations.coordinates_source: osm place 户部山古建筑群 (Hubu Hill, old city centre) from candidates.json; Pipeline C to replace with the OSM place=city point
destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage has a page 'Xuzhou' (See entries for Guishan, Hubu Hill, aquarium); Travel China Guide and Chinatripedia give Xuzhou its own chapter built on Han tombs and Yunlong Lake.
destinations.rank_reason: Regional city with strong Han-heritage identity but outside the main Jiangsu itineraries: rank 4.
destinations.near_standalone_note: No standalone kept spot within 40 km.

destinations.name: Lianyungang
destinations.coordinates_source: approximate centre between Haizhou/Xinpu and the Huaguo-Yuntai range from the kept spots' candidates.json coordinates; Pipeline C to confirm the OSM place=city point
destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage has a page 'Lianyungang' listing the city museum, beach and mountain sights; Mount Huaguo (Monkey King's home, Journey to the West) is the named headline attraction; Travel China Guide and Chinatripedia cover Lianyungang as one chapter.
destinations.rank_reason: Coastal prefecture city with Mount Huaguo and Lian Island but niche for international visitors: rank 4.
destinations.near_standalone_note: Xishuang Lake (~51 km) is in Donghai County, outside the bounds and beyond 75% of the span: standalone.
